In tests/lane-sessions.test.ts: with HERDR_ENV unset or HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID empty and default config, single-task and Initiative Host entries return lane_session_unavailable listing herdr and herdr-core reasons and recoveries, create zero Lane worktrees and zero sessions, and never return lane_executor_requires_tui.

In tests/lane-sessions.test.ts: an active v3 batch recorded with session_provider herdr re-entered via advanceLanes with HERDR_ENV unset under an injected registry where herdr-core admits the Host refuses lane_session_unavailable naming herdr without switching providers; re-entered with HERDR_ENV=1 and HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID=ws1 it reconciles existing handles via observe/find and opens zero duplicate tabs; with the fake herdr CLI, the SessionPortAdapter reports a pane_not_found handle as exited and any other provider failure as unknown.

In tests/lane-sessions.test.ts through v4_runtime imm-session dispatch with fake provider: imm-session await --batch <id> waits read-only and returns at the first D20 wake event (a child observed idle, done, blocked, or exited; entry_submitted false; a Kernel settlement or pending user decision) or at timeout, reporting next_action advance after a settlement, relay_dialog for a blocked startup dialog, ask_user for an interactive_host child stalled at baseline, wait on a timeout with nothing pending, and complete for a terminal batch; imm-session send --batch <id> and imm-session stop --batch <id> fail with usage exit code 2 (negative controls); an unknown batch id returns a refusal with exit code 1.

attestations.summary: Round-4 delta threads executor_freeze {request, parentHost} from lane_sessions toBatchInput into the existing StartBatchInput.executor_freeze consumed by batch_lanes.ts frozenExecutorPreferences, mirrored identically in the Antigravity copy and both bundles, and pins resume-from-another-Host regeneration on the frozen host/argv in tests/lane-sessions.test.ts; blast radius medium (lane_sessions composition root, persisted v3 executor_preferences).

findings.summary: Outside Herdr, a Host entry with the default config refuses lane_session_unavailable but names no provider at all, so neither the herdr nor the herdr-core reason or recovery is listed.

evidence.trigger: HERDR_ENV unset and default config (session_providers defaults to ["herdr"] per runtime/config/layered_config.ts). Host start_unattended_batch reaches the sessionProviders IIFE in host-core/runtime.ts, which filters out "herdr" when not inside Herdr, so providers is []. resolveSessionProvider then loops over nothing and returns reasons []. refusalFromReasons([]) yields reason "lane_session_unavailable: " with no provider names and only the fallback recovery, and runtime.ts drops the reasons array when it maps the refusal to {state:"rejected"}. Observable result: the Host refusal lists neither herdr nor herdr-core. The tests miss this: tests/lane-sessions.test.ts HLS-A2 calls startLanes directly and overrides providers to ["herdr","herdr-core"], not the default-config Host-entry path, and the Host suites (tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts) only assert the substring lane_session_unavailable. Fix the provider list so the default-config Host refusal names herdr and herdr-core with their reasons and recoveries, and pin it at the Host-entry seam for single-task and Initiative.

findings.summary: With the real Herdr provider, SessionPortAdapter never reports a pane_not_found handle as exited, because herdr observeState returns ok with state unknown for a gone pane; the test pins this with a synthetic FakeSupervised refusal instead of the fake herdr CLI.

evidence.trigger: A Lane session whose Herdr pane has closed. The fake herdr CLI answers `pane get` with error code pane_not_found. In herdr_provider.ts, own() returns {gone:true}, and observeState then returns {ok:true, state:"unknown"}, not a refusal. SessionPortAdapter.observe only maps pane_not_found when it finds the text inside a refusal reason, so it returns unknown. The S4 reconciler holds on unknown, so the exited child is never closed with proof or advanced to the next generation. Observable result: a pane_not_found handle is reported as unknown instead of exited. Unchanged file read: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/session/herdr_provider.ts (createHerdrSessionProvider.observeState), because the changed session_port_adapter.ts wraps it directly and HLS-A3 names it. The HLS-A3 adapter test uses FakeSupervised, which returns a refusal whose reason contains "pane_not_found"; that replaces the agreed fake-herdr-CLI seam. Fix the mapping for the provider's gone-pane outcome and drive the test through createHerdrSessionProvider with the fake herdr CLI.

findings.summary: Host Lane entry silently drops the requested Executor profile (agents.executor host/model/effort): startLanes always opens sessions with this.parentHost and empty hostArgs, and the parity test that would catch it was weakened.

evidence.trigger: Claude Code Host inside Herdr calls start_unattended_batch { initiative_slug, agents: { executor: "pi" } } → runtime.ts laneDeps passes host: this.parentHost (claude-code) and no executor_freeze/hostArgs, options.executor is no longer read anywhere in host-core/runtime.ts, batch_lanes.ts frozenExecutorPreferences(root, undefined, undefined) records no request, and SessionPortAdapter.open uses its fixed host (BatchSessionOpenInput carries no host) → each Lane opens a claude-code Executor tab instead of the requested pi Executor, with no refusal or diagnostic. tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts 'both Hosts give equal Lane reports' removed the full-report parity assertion expect(normalize(a.report)).toEqual(normalize(b.report)) and now compares only empty handoffs, so the divergence is unasserted. Fix: carry the frozen executor request (executor_freeze / executor_preferences host and args) into startLanes/advanceLanes and the adapter's host/hostArgs, and restore an assertion that a requested executor host is the one opened.

findings.summary: startLanes opens sessions with the requested Executor profile but never freezes it into the v3 record, so advanceLanes re-entry opens regenerated or missing child sessions on a different Host and argv than the batch started with.

evidence.trigger: Claude Code Parent inside Herdr, no configured executor role, start_unattended_batch with agents.executor pi:m@high → startLanes opens pi tabs with --model m --thinking high, but toBatchInput passes neither executor_freeze nor supervision, so batch_lanes.ts:1019-1020 calls frozenExecutorPreferences(root, undefined, undefined) and the record has no executor_preferences (or, with a configured executor role, freezes that role instead); a later re-entry without agents.executor (HostRuntime laneDeps omits executor) hits advanceLanes, where executorSessionTarget falls back to the Parent Host or the configured role → a regenerated session (exited child, g(n+1)) or a not-yet-opened child opens claude-code with no model/effort flags instead of pi, contradicting the delta's own comment 'Resume honors the record's frozen Executor profile'. Unchanged batch_lanes.ts was read only because the changed caller toBatchInput feeds its freeze step; the new test covers startLanes only and asserts no resume case.
